title: Tanker Hit by Multiple Projectiles Off Qatar; Iran Signals Full Hormuz Blockade
detail: UKMTO reports a tanker was struck by multiple projectiles off the north coast of Qatar. Iran separately claimed the route transporting oil through the Strait of Hormuz will be 'closed', marking the most direct threat of a full blockade since the crisis began. The incident escalates maritime risk across the Persian Gulf beyond the strait itself.

media.caption: Tanker struck by multiple projectiles off north coast of Qatar as Iran threatens full Hormuz closure
